finding: Low-bot YARN shortfall is exactly external market inflow minus treasury and final wallets. Retained Spool is excluded from burns. At 1.15 the mean deficit is 78.711341 YARN; 1.20 increases it to 114.367742 in the original block.

High-bot Star source/sink is exactly 1 + retained Star balances / actual sinks. At 1.15 mean balances are 414.185 versus 407.448 allowed by the mean sink amount; inactive balances are included. These mean amounts explain the ledger, not the median ratio.

Large remaining Epic inventories and thousands of unpolished slots coexist with repeated insufficient-YARN purchase attempts; adding combat-generated materials alone is not supported as the limiting remedy.

The two native banks have identical median first-Legendary and level-15 dates in every profile. The 1.20 scalar changes their subsequent records but has no robust token improvement: all paired 95% ratio-difference intervals for the failed boundaries include zero.
Independent token seeds reproduce both failures. The small high-bot Star median improvement reverses direction in the holdout.

Gear-only hybrid improves low-bot burnClaims by 0.0024730147 but reaches only 0.9947185671; progression-only reaches 0.9907852586. High-bot Stars remain 1.1014655147 and 1.1016305618 respectively. Neither pathway probe repairs its boundary.
